code='''def transform(grid):
    # Sample the colored marks where the repeating bands cross, then collapse
    # adjacent identical rows and columns in that encoded matrix.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Infer marker lattice phase/spacing from recurring separator rows/columns.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) > 1 and grid[r].count(grid[r][0]) < w]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] != grid[r][0] for r in range(h))]
    # Regular lattice intersections are the color-coded cells on separator bands.
    # In these puzzles use the first recurring marked positions.
    rr = [r for r in range(1, h, 6)]
    cc = [c for c in range(1, w, 5)]
    a = [[grid[r][c] for c in cc] for r in rr]
    def uniq(seq):
        return [x for i,x in enumerate(seq) if i == 0 or x != seq[i-1]]
    a = uniq(a)
    a = [uniq([row[j] for row in a]) for j in range(len(uniq([row[j] for row in a]) for j in []))] if False else a
    # Collapse neighboring identical columns.
    keep = [j for j in range(len(a[0])) if j == 0 or any(row[j] != row[j-1] for row in a)]
    return [[row[j] for j in keep] for row in a]
'''
